channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Eleitor em Dia: cadastro eleitoral ficará fechado até 3 de novembro
item.description: The electoral registry will be closed starting May 7 to prepare for the 2026 elections, as mandated by the Elections Law. Those who did not obtain their voter ID or regularize their status by November 3 will be unable to vote in the October elections. Despite the closure, services such as certificate issuance, fine payment, title printing, and inquiries remain available via the Electoral Self-Service portal of the TSE and regional TREs.

item.title: Lula diz que não discutiu com Trump classificação de PCC e CV como organizações terroristas
item.description: Lula stated that there was no discussion with Trump regarding the potential U.S. designation of PCC and CV as terrorist organizations during their three-hour meeting. The Brazilian president clarified that the topic was not raised in the conversation.

item.title: Caso Master mudou de patamar
item.description: The Federal Police operation against Senator Ciro Nogueira, president of the PP and a centrão oligarch, has pushed the Master case into the 2026 presidential succession race, intensifying the political toxicity of the scandal. The fallout is expected to reach other prominent figures from parties that had been negotiating alliances with Flávio Bolsonaro’s candidacy, threatening the cohesion of the conservative bloc.

item.title: Lula diz que reunião não mudará visão de Trump sobre guerras
item.description: Lula stated that his three-hour meeting with Trump at the White House would not change the U.S. president’s approach to international conflicts, emphasizing clear differences in their worldviews, particularly regarding Iran and Venezuela. He advocated dialogue as a more effective and humane alternative to war, saying 'talking is much cheaper, more effective,' and noted he would not engage in confrontation over their divergent views.

item.title: Áudio: Sancionado o programa 'Antes que aconteça', de proteção à mulher
item.description: President Lula signed Law 15.398/2026, creating the 'Antes que aconteça' program to prevent domestic violence and femicide, including educational actions, victim support, and AI monitoring of aggressors. The bill originated from PL 6.674/2025 by Senator Daniella Ribeiro (PP-PB).

item.title: Se precisar que converse com Cuba, estamos dispostos, diz Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that Brazil is willing to engage in dialogue with Cuba regarding U.S. embargoes, if necessary, following his meeting with Donald Trump at the White House. Lula said the Cuba issue was discussed during the meeting and reiterated his criticism of the U.S. economic embargo against Cuba, which he claims has hindered the country's full development since the 1959 revolution. He also emphasized that his primary purpose for the visit was to discuss Brazilian matters and not to shift the agenda's focus.

item.title: Lula brinca com Trump sobre vistos para jogadores brasileiros na Copa
item.description: Lula joked with Trump about the need for visas for Brazilian soccer players in the 2026 World Cup, saying he hopes Trump won’t cancel the documents since Brazil is coming 'to win'. Trump reportedly laughed in response, according to Lula. The Washington meeting was Lula’s second visit to the U.S. this term, focusing on organized crime, U.S. trade investigation against Brazil, and rare minerals exploration, amid recent trade tensions.

item.title: Setor empresarial pede redução de encargos trabalhistas e critica fim da escala 6x1
item.description: Business representatives, including Fecomércio, the São Paulo Commercial Association, and Fiesp, urged for reduced labor and tax burdens to enhance Brazilian product competitiveness, opposing proposals to end the 6x1 work schedule, particularly during an election year. The 'Brazil Cost' was estimated at R$ 1.5 trillion annually, with domestic products priced 24.1% higher on average than imports and a tax burden of 32.5% of GDP.

item.title: “Melhor do que de cara feia”: Lula diz ter aconselhado Trump a sorrir
item.description: Lula said he advised Trump to smile more during a three-hour meeting at the White House, stating that a smiling expression is better than a grim one in photographs. Trump reportedly found the comment funny and learned that 'laughing is very good'. Lula described the meeting as friendly and said he had a 30-day deadline to advance trade negotiations, covering topics such as tariffs, rare earth minerals, and organized crime.

item.title: Posse do ministro Nunes Marques na Presidência do TSE será na próxima terça (12)
item.description: Minister Nunes Marques will be sworn in as president of the TSE next Tuesday (12) at 7 p.m. in Brasília, with André Mendonça assuming the vice-presidency. The new administration will oversee the 2026 General Elections, focusing on electronic voting security, combating disinformation, and strengthening public trust in the electoral system. The inauguration follows the seniority criterion among STF justices composing the TSE, upholding the institution’s tradition of rotational leadership.

item.title: Veja fotos do encontro entre Lula e Trump nos EUA
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva met with Donald Trump in Washington on May 7, 2026 to discuss bilateral trade, tariffs, cooperation against transnational crime, and critical minerals. The meeting was described as positive by both leaders, marking Lula’s second visit to the U.S. during his current term after a period of trade tensions and diplomatic distance since Trump’s second term began in 2025. The meeting included Brazilian ministers and U.S. officials such as J.D. Vance and Scott Bessent.

item.title: 30 anos da Urna Eletrônica: adoção do equipamento agilizou voto e eliminou fraudes
item.description: The electronic voting machine was first introduced in the 1996 Municipal Elections, marking 30 years of innovation in Brazil's electoral process. It replaced paper ballots, eliminating fraud, losses, and human errors, while promoting inclusion for illiterate and disabled voters. A TSE series explores its history, operation, transparency, and democratic impact.

item.title: Entenda os motivos que levaram o Ibovespa a cair mais de 2% nesta quinta-feira
item.description: The Ibovespa fell more than 2% due to declining Petrobras shares, driven by lower oil prices following signs of a possible ceasefire between the U.S. and Iran, and weak Q1 results from Bradesco, which showed deteriorating asset quality. Although the meeting between Lula and Trump was called 'productive,' the market remained indifferent, awaiting tangible outcomes from any agreement.

item.title: “Amor à primeira vista”: Lula e Trump trocam elogios após reunião
item.description: Lula and Trump exchanged public praise after a three-hour meeting at the White House, describing their relationship as 'love at first sight' and highlighting productive talks on trade, tariffs, security, and investments. Lula said he left satisfied and confirmed no topics were off-limits except democracy and sovereignty.

item.title: Lula fala sozinho com a imprensa após reunião com Trump
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva held a solo press briefing at the Brazilian Embassy in Washington D.C. after a private 3-hour meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump, during which they discussed organized crime, a U.S.-initiated trade investigation against Brazil, and negotiations over rare mineral exploration by American companies. Trump did not make public statements after the meeting but called Lula a 'dynamic leader' on his Truth Social account. The meeting marked the third in-person encounter between the leaders and took place amid ongoing trade tensions, including U.S. tariffs of up to 50% on Brazilian goods imposed since Trump’s second term began in January 2025.

item.title: “Panela de pressão”
item.description: Prison officers in São Paulo denounce unhealthy working conditions, with a 39% staffing deficit, rising mental illness, and suicides — six in 2025 and four by April 2026. The case of Natália Cristina Raphael Fernandes, widow of prison officer Marcelo Augusto Raphael Fernandes, who died by suicide after moral harassment and false accusations, highlights the systemic crisis at Pirajuí prison. Despite her request for humanitarian transfer, it was denied, while Governor Tarcísio de Freitas has not held new competitions and allowed the last one to expire.

item.title: Cadê o carteiro?
item.description: Brazil's Postal Service is undergoing downsizing and de-characterization due to a voluntary layoff plan with low uptake (3,075 of 10,000 expected), despite operational improvements such as over 90% on-time deliveries and a 23.9-point rise in customer satisfaction. A cumulative loss of R$8.5 billion over four consecutive years fuels privatization pressures, while unions warn that reducing the workforce from 90,000 to 76,000 undermines service quality in a continental-sized nation.

item.title: O dilema de Lula
item.description: Lula faces a political dilemma after two significant congressional defeats: the rejection of his Supreme Court nominee and the overturning of his veto on a law reducing Bolsonaro’s sentence. Despite being labeled a 'lame duck,' he sought to strengthen his international standing by meeting with Trump in Washington, focusing on cooperation against organized crime, trade tariffs, and preventing U.S. support for Flávio Bolsonaro’s campaign. The PT strategy aims to use dialogue with Trump to project an image of balance and experience amid global turmoil, especially the Iran war.

item.title: Cartas Capitais
item.description: The text warns that democracy is declining in countries adopting Trump-inspired far-right practices, stressing the need to prevent this movement from advancing in Brazil to secure Lula’s re-election. Although it describes the situation as dire, it asserts that reversal is possible through sustained political struggle and activism.

item.title: Lula: “Se Trump tentou interferir nas eleições, ele perdeu”
item.description: Lula stated that if Donald Trump attempted to interfere in Brazilian elections, he failed, as Lula won the election. He emphasized the sovereignty of the Brazilian people in choosing their leaders and rejected any discussion of foreign support for the 2026 elections, despite describing his relationship with Trump as sincere and evolving.

item.title: Líder do governo diz que Senado deve votar ainda em maio projeto das terras raras, assunto entre Lula e Trump
item.description: The government leader in the Senate, Senator Randolfe Rodrigues (PT-AP), stated that the bill creating a legal framework for critical minerals and rare earths should be voted on in May. The proposal, already approved by the Chamber of Deputies, was discussed by President Lula with Donald Trump as a matter of national sovereignty, following efforts to secure its passage before their meeting.

item.title: Amcham vê avanço em encontro entre Lula e Trump e espera solução para investigação comercial dos EUA
item.description: Amcham Brazil praised the meeting between Presidents Lula and Trump, stating it strengthens high-level dialogue and creates favorable conditions for advancing strategic economic issues. The group also expressed hope for a resolution to the U.S. Section 301 investigation into alleged unfair trade practices by Brazil.

item.title: Brasil e EUA encerram reunião sem fechar acordo sobre tarifas
item.description: Lula and Trump met at the White House to discuss trade tariffs, investments, and other bilateral issues. The meeting ended without an agreement on the tariffs imposed by the U.S., but Lula proposed a 30-day deadline to resolve the disagreements and expressed optimism about the negotiations' progress.

item.title: Lula sobre operação contra Ciro Nogueira: "Espero que sejam inocentes"
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva commented on the Federal Police's Operation Compliance Zero targeting Senator Ciro Nogueira, stating he hopes those investigated are innocent, with an ironic tone. He emphasized the operation was authorized by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça and carried out by the Federal Police, noting he was in Washington after meeting with Donald Trump. Nogueira, an ally of Flávio Bolsonaro, is under investigation for alleged monthly payments from Banco Master, reaching up to R$ 500,000.

item.title: Ciro Nogueira já apoiou Lula e Bolsonaro: veja trajetória do senador
item.description: Senator Ciro Nogueira, currently an ally of Bolsonaro and a leading opposition figure, has a political history of supporting various presidents since the 1990s, including Lula and Workers' Party governments, and has previously declared his vote for Lula. His trajectory reflects a long-standing presence in governmental coalitions, despite his current opposition to the Lula administration.

item.title: Cármen Lúcia critica violência de gênero em última sessão como presidente do TSE
item.description: Minister Cármen Lúcia concluded her presidency at the TSE by criticizing the 'barbaric' gender-based violence faced by women in positions of power during the Court's final session. She was honored by colleagues at the end of her term leading the electoral tribunal.

item.title: Trump disse que não considera invadir Cuba, diz Lula
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva said that U.S. President Donald Trump told him, via an interpreter, that he has no intention of invading Cuba. The statement, made in Washington, aims to ease long-standing tensions between the two countries regarding Cuba.

item.title: Lula cita dosimetria e diz ter entregue a Trump lista de autoridades com vistos dos EUA suspensos
item.description: President Lula (PT) stated that he delivered to Donald Trump a list of Brazilian authorities whose U.S. visas are suspended, citing the approval of the dosimetry bill as a factor that could reduce sentences and facilitate entry permissions. He also joked with Trump about visas for Brazilian national team players during the 2026 World Cup, to be held in the U.S., Mexico, and Canada. Lula noted this is the second meeting between the two leaders to discuss bilateral issues.

item.title: Lula brinca com Trump sobre vistos de jogadores da Seleção Brasileira
item.description: President Lula joked with Donald Trump during their White House meeting, asking him not to cancel visas for Brazilian soccer players ahead of the World Cup hosted in the U.S. The three-hour discussion covered trade, tariffs, organized crime, and critical minerals, with both leaders describing the meeting as productive.

item.title: STM diz que aumento de penduricalhos respeita decisão do STF
item.description: The STM states that the increase in penduricalhos for military judiciary magistrates complies with the STF's decision, following three resolutions passed in April that reclassified the Cumulative Jurisdiction Exercise Gratuity as indemnity, allowing payments above the constitutional ceiling. The change follows STF and CNJ/CNMP guidelines, per Joint Resolution No. 14/2026, and is supported by Law No. 13,096/2015.

item.title: Guerras, terras raras e Copa: veja ponto a ponto o que Lula discutiu com Trump na Casa Branca
item.description: Lula and Trump met at the White House to discuss revitalizing Brazil-U.S. relations, focusing on economic partnership, trade, and multilateralism. Topics included rare earth minerals, UN Security Council reform, and a lighthearted comment about the World Cup, while Lula denied discussions on labeling Brazilian factions as terrorist groups or U.S. attacks on PIX. Lula expressed optimism, noting mutual interest in strengthening dialogue and creating a bilateral working group to address trade barriers within 30 days.

item.title: Flávio diz que são ‘graves’ acusações contra Ciro Nogueira, aliado dos Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) described the accusations against Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI), a longtime ally of Jair Bolsonaro, as 'grave' in relation to the Federal Police operation investigating irregularities at Banco Master. Nogueira, former minister and national president of the PP, is suspected of receiving R$300,000 in a 'monthly allowance' from banker Daniel Vorcaro and of presenting an amendment drafted by the bank’s staff to benefit the institution. Flávio emphasized the need for a rigorous and transparent investigation, expressing confidence in the rapporteurship of Minister André Mendonça at the Supreme Court.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula e Trump não falaram sobre Pix, CV e PCC?
item.description: President Lula stated that his meeting with Donald Trump did not cover the Pix system or the potential designation of PCC and Comando Vermelho as terrorist organizations. He said Trump 'did not touch on the subject' of Pix and noted he brought Finance Minister Dario Durigan specifically to address economic issues like this.

item.title: O afago de Lula em Messias antes de embarcar para encontro com Trump
item.description: President Lula offered support to Jorge Messias after his Senate rejection for the STF, framing the vote as a political rebuke from Congress rather than a judgment on his qualifications. Messias wishes to leave the AGU due to tensions with lawmakers and judges, but Lula urges him to stay, possibly reassigning him to lead the Ministry of Justice. The meeting took place before Lula's trip to Washington to meet with Trump.

item.title: Brasil e EUA ampliarão cooperação contra armas e lavagem de dinheiro
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan announced that Brazil and the U.S. have advanced cooperation against organized crime, including remote container monitoring, seizure of over half a ton of illegal weapons, and more than one ton of synthetic drugs flowing from the U.S. to Brazil. The collaboration also includes financial intelligence sharing via Operation Hidden Carbon, linking Brazil’s Federal Revenue and the U.S. IRS to combat money laundering and tax evasion, with traced funds linked to Delaware.

item.title: Lula consegue 30 dias para negociar com Trump sobre tarifas
item.description: Lula left the White House meeting with Trump with a 30-day deadline to advance trade negotiations between Brazil and the U.S. Brazil presented data showing an average import tariff of 2.7% on U.S. goods, challenging U.S. overtariffs, and the trade deficit was highlighted as a central issue in the talks.

item.title: Lula e Trump não discutiram CV e PCC na Casa Branca
item.description: Lula confirmed that the Comando Vermelho and PCC were not discussed during his three-hour meeting with Trump at the White House, contrary to expectations of U.S. designation of Brazilian factions as terrorist groups. He proposed a multilateral working group to combat organized crime in Latin America, criticizing the traditional U.S. military-focused approach and advocating for economic alternatives for vulnerable populations. Lula also announced he will present a national plan against organized crime in Brazil next week.

item.title: Lula diz não acreditar em interferência de Trump nas eleições: ‘Quem vota é o povo brasileiro’
item.description: President Lula said he does not believe Donald Trump will interfere in Brazilian elections, emphasizing that 'the Brazilian people vote'. He stressed that national sovereignty must be respected and that Brazil-U.S. relations are sincere despite political differences.

item.title: 71,8% em SC defendem impeachment de ministros do STF, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Futura/Apex poll shows that 71.8% of voters in Santa Catarina support the impeachment of STF ministers, while 17.7% oppose it and 10.5% did not know how to respond. The survey, conducted with 800 voters from April 24 to 25, has a margin of error of 3.5 percentage points and a 95% confidence level.

item.title: 'Não precisamos inventar nada para a imprensa', diz Lula sobre ter pedido mudança em protocolo de encontro com Trump
item.description: President Lula explained that he requested a change in the protocol for his meeting with Trump to avoid a press conference before the talks, stating there's no need to 'invent anything for the press' and that the focus should be on substantive discussion. The meeting, lasting over three hours, ended without a press conference, following Lula's discomfort in a prior encounter in Malaysia.

item.title: Jorginho Mello é aprovado por 77,9% dos eleitores em SC, diz pesquisa
item.description: Santa Catarina Governor Jorginho Mello (PL) enjoys a 77.9% approval rating among state voters, according to a Futura/Apex poll conducted April 24–25 with 800 respondents. His administration is rated as 'excellent' or 'good' by 69.7%, while 18.5% disapprove and 3.5% did not respond. The survey has a 3.5 percentage point margin of error and 95% confidence level, and is registered with the TSE under BR-01971/2026.

item.title: Lula diz que Trump não terá ‘qualquer influência’ nas eleições brasileiras
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that Donald Trump will have no influence on Brazil's 2026 elections, emphasizing that the vote belongs to the Brazilian people. He added that he expects Trump to act as U.S. president and respect Brazil's democratic choice.

item.title: Trump nem tocou no assunto do Pix, diz Lula após reunião na Casa Branca
item.description: Lula stated that Trump did not mention the Pix during a nearly three-hour meeting at the White House, despite expectations that the topic would be raised. The Brazilian president said he had included the Finance Minister in his delegation anticipating the discussion, but since Trump did not bring up Pix, Lula also avoided addressing it. The instant payment system is under commercial investigation by the U.S., which claims preferential treatment by Brazil's Central Bank disadvantages American payment service providers.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz considerar ‘grave’ ação da PF contra Ciro Nogueira, ex-ministro de seu pai
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) described as 'grave' the Federal Police operation targeting Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI), former minister of Jair Bolsonaro, in an investigation linked to Banco Master and businessman Daniel Vorcaro. The PF executed search and seizure warrants in four states, including Nogueira’s Brasília residence, and froze R$ 18.8 million in assets, authorized by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça. Flávio stressed the need for rigorous and transparent investigation, expressing confidence in the rapporteurship of the minister appointed by his father.

item.title: EUA e Brasil vão criar grupo de trabalho para discutir tarifas nos próximos 30 dias, anuncia Lula
item.description: President Lula announced that Brazil and the U.S. will establish a working group to discuss the removal of U.S. tariffs on Brazilian products within the next 30 days. The announcement was made during a press conference at the Brazilian Embassy in Washington, following a meeting with Donald Trump. Lula also emphasized the approval of the critical minerals bill and Brazil’s openness to international partnerships for rare earth exploration.

item.title: Lula diz esperar que Trump um dia faça um sistema como o PIX e que americano não tocou no tema durante reunião
item.description: Lula stated that Donald Trump did not bring up the topic of PIX during their meeting at the White House, despite having brought the Finance Minister to discuss it. He jokingly said he hopes Trump will one day create a similar instant payment system, noting that many American companies already use such technology. PIX has been under commercial investigation in the U.S., viewed as a threat to credit card giants and dollar dominance in global trade.

item.title: Trump dá à União Europeia prazo até 4 de julho para implementar acordo comercial com EUA
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has given the European Union a July 4 deadline to implement the trade agreement reached last July, warning that tariffs would rise significantly if the bloc fails to fulfill its commitment to reduce tariffs to zero. Trump described the deal as 'the greatest trade deal of all time' and linked the deadline to the 250th anniversary of American independence. Although the EU Parliament has delayed ratification pending details on U.S. trade policy, negotiators say they are making progress, with a next meeting scheduled for May 19.

item.title: “Se ele tentou interferir nas eleições, ele perdeu. Porque eu ganhei”, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula (PT) stated he does not fear external interference in Brazil's 2026 elections, saying that if Donald Trump attempted to interfere in the 2022 elections, he lost because Lula won. Lula noted that during the 2022 Brazilian election, the U.S. president was Joe Biden, not Trump.

item.title: Lula celebra discussão positiva de ‘tabus’ com Trump e anuncia grupos de trabalho: ‘Satisfeito’
item.description: Lula praised a nearly three-hour conversation with Donald Trump on 'taboo' topics such as organized crime, announcing working groups for cooperation in economy, mineral exploration, and security. He advocated for economic alternatives to narcotrafficking, criticizing the U.S. militarized approach and proposing a South American and global coalition. The meeting took place in Washington after a White House press event was canceled, and both sides described it as productive and friendly.

item.title: Lula diz que facções não foi tema em conversa com Trump e que o combate ao crime organizado não deve envolver 'base militar'
item.description: Lula stated that his conversation with Trump did not include discussions about labeling Brazilian criminal factions as terrorist groups, and emphasized that combating organized crime requires economic alternatives, not military bases. He argued that as long as poverty and demand exist, drug trafficking will persist, and proposed an international task force led by Brazil to address the issue through shared responsibility.
